question: The storage/myairbridge record states its transfer limit as 20 GiB (unit GiB) across free_tier, per_object_cap and limits, while first-party pages (info.myairbridge.com/en/faq and /en/plans) state 20 GB (decimal). Should the unit notation be normalized to GB?
why: A unit normalization touches several GiB-bearing fields and is a notation change rather than a changed allowance; this lane does not guess at a broad conversion.
